services.source: Derived from the 3 verbatim Google reviews (plumbing, electrical, painting, bathroom change) and the business's own Google photos (interior painting, closet/door carpentry, bathroom finish, pressure-washed driveway). Nothing invented.
services.pricing_note: No price list found anywhere public. Site uses the adapted variant: every job is quoted, call for a price, nothing invented.

reviews_verbatim.name: Alfonso Suarez
reviews_verbatim.text: I consider Mario a friend and a great professional. He can handle many types of jobs and always keeps his cool, has patience and finds a way to meet deadlines while delivering the highest quality work.

reviews_verbatim.name: Roberto Alvarez
reviews_verbatim.text: Mario has done several plumbing, electric, and painting jobs at our home for over a year at reasonable prices. His work is excellent. He has always shown responsiveness for which I highly recommend him for any handyman services.

reviews_verbatim.name: Cesar Moreno
reviews_verbatim.text: Excellent work, the guys from Mava Services, the change they made in my bathroom was great.

reviews_note: 3 real verbatim Google reviews, collected via scripts/maps_research.py directly from the live Google Business Profile. Owner/operator name 'Mario' comes from 2 of the 3 reviews.
